# My Recovery Toolkit

> A zero-knowledge, offline-first Progressive Web App for 12-Step and Buddhist-inspired recovery. Sensitive user data (journals, workbook answers, sponsee notes) is encrypted client-side with AES-GCM before being stored — the server never has access to unencrypted content.

My Recovery Toolkit (MRT) combines encrypted journaling, CBT/SMART tools, habit tracking, AI-powered pattern insights, and gamified recovery exercises, built for people in 12-Step (AA/NA) and Buddhist-inspired (Recovery Dharma, SMART) recovery programs.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.myrecoverytoolkit.ca/): Product overview and sign-up.
- [User Guide](https://docs.myrecoverytoolkit.ca/guide/01-getting-started): Full documentation of every feature.
- [FAQ](https://docs.myrecoverytoolkit.ca/support/faq): Answers on zero-knowledge encryption, offline support, AI data handling, and account deletion.
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.myrecoverytoolkit.ca/privacy): How data is collected, encrypted, and protected.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.myrecoverytoolkit.ca/tos): Terms of use, including the medical disclaimer.
- [Changelog](https://docs.myrecoverytoolkit.ca/support/changelog): Version-by-version history.

## Notes

- MRT is a self-help peer support tool. It is not a medical device, diagnostic tool, or a replacement for professional clinical addiction treatment.
- Most of the app requires an authenticated account and is intentionally not publicly crawlable — the pages listed above are the complete public surface.
